data.change_summary: Added jam detection logic per narrative §3 and CE-ST10-03 in rungs R8 and R9: timer T10 (5.0 s, K50) times while conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) runs and entry photo-eye PE-1002 (X11) is blocked. When T10 completes, it latches jam alarm M190 (SET M190). Active M190 drives ST10 fault summary M199, which stops conveyor motor Y10 via ANI M199 until cleared by fault reset PB-0002 (X1).
data.program_il:
; ST10_CONVEYOR (FX5U) - converted from FX3U project CV_ST1_V2, 2019

LDI    X13
OUT    M191             ; ST10 motor overload alarm

LD     X1
RST    M190

LD     M190
OR     M191             ; ST10 motor overload alarm
ORI    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop chain healthy
OUT    M199

LD     X2               ; SS-0003 auto mode
ANI    M199
OUT    Y10

LD     X10
OUT    M100             ; ST10 pallet in position

LDP    X14              ; RQ-1005 release request
SET    Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release

LD     Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release
OUT    T11 K20

LD     T11
RST    Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release

LD     Y10
AND    X11
OUT    T10 K50

LD     T10
SET    M190             ; ST10 jam alarm

END
